name: frontend-delivery-integration
title: Frontend delivery integration and separation
description: Integrate completed Web UI work, audit the combined frontend, and make the existing web package deployable independently while preserving same-origin authentication.
creator: codex
notes: Ready for upstream review. The Web code remains a standalone application package inside the monorepo; static frontend and Python API services may deploy separately behind one HTTPS origin. PR 2 is open and intentionally unmerged. Remaining gates are isolated PostgreSQL validation, live Telegram/WeChat acceptance, the real backend origin, and maintainer-owned Vercel authorization.
